Software Engineer, AI Platform (New Grad)
Lumen Labs - New York, NY (Hybrid)

About the role
Lumen Labs builds infrastructure that lets product teams ship features powered by large language models. As a new-grad engineer on the AI Platform team you'll build the backend services that sit between our products and model providers: request routing, caching, rate limiting, evaluation, and observability.

What you'll do
- Design and build Python services (FastAPI) that serve millions of LLM requests a day
- Improve latency and cost through caching, batching and smart model routing
- Build reliable systems: retries, failover, circuit breakers and graceful degradation
- Instrument everything with metrics and tracing (Prometheus, Grafana)
- Write well-tested code (pytest) and ship through CI/CD with Docker and Kubernetes
- Work with embeddings and vector search for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

What we're looking for
- BS/MS in Computer Science or a related field (graduating 2026-2027)
- Strong Python; experience building REST APIs
- Familiarity with LLMs, embeddings, or ML systems
- Experience with SQL databases such as PostgreSQL
- Bonus: Go, Kubernetes, Kafka, or experience with distributed systems

We sponsor work visas for eligible candidates.
